source_observable: Full spatial gradient energy in an explicit equal-lab-time remnant window, not GW power
temporal_extension: Stationary replay at the actual scalar-weight loss time is an explicit model assumption
tail_policy: Not defined by calibration. Queries beyond age_d_supported require a separately declared continuation.
normalization_policy: Raw positive measured fraction ratios; no monotonic envelope, clipping, fit or tail extension
limitations: Only gamma=4 has been measured in this patch calibration.
Fixed-annulus and fixed-rapidity cohorts are prescribed geometry, not conserved material labels.
A scalar gradient-energy fraction is not a TT source-amplitude fraction or a GW-power weight.
Kernel geometry already uses laboratory time; do not apply a second Milne-clock conversion.
No third-bubble response or new field evolution is included.
